method: Read-only independent recomputation from every raw launch/stdout/stderr record, saved point/variant configuration, exact module/tool identities and all retained summaries. No build, emitted program, runtime or benchmark executed by this audit.
limits: Five samples per side are descriptive observations, not a confidence bound or universal performance guarantee.
Recorded child intervals establish serialized acquisition, not whole-machine physical isolation.
Import and warmup are excluded from executionMs; result assertions/checksum updates are included.
Measurement targets are extrapolated from calibration, not enforced minimum block durations.
Only normal generated JavaScript library execution is measured; no current full self-emitted compiler H throughput.

counterComparison.finding: All18 old/candidate counter rows are identical between inline and shared acquisitions; each shared acquisition uses the exact correct runtime prefix and passes7counter controls. Dynamic counted operations alone therefore do not explain different short-window timing behavior.

recommendation.promote: shared-helper only, conditional on the separately recorded scoped correctness/installation gates
recommendation.reason: Shared-helper representative short and longer-warm regressions are small with overlapping observed ranges; several kernels improve by roughly2-6%, including the actual compiler membership component after longer warmup. The inline variant has a clear20.08% short-window term regression and remains unpromoted.
doNotClaim: Elimination of final partial descriptors or field-copy arrays
recommendation.inlineVariant: Reject as-is; retain all samples and warmup-specific outcomes.
